text:
priya: Heads up — AcmeCorp reported a p99 spike on chat API around 10:29 PST. Baseline ~220ms, p99 jumped to ~650ms for long-sequence traffic. They say this started after the recent runtime rollout.
mike: I see the alert. Correlating with kernel rollout logs — we flipped a compile flag for flashattn optimizations in the last deploy (7060000000). Might be related.
samir: Any repro yet? Need a minimal repro to validate kernel path.
priya: Support provided a sample request: model=redwood-chat-1, seq_len ~1024, batch=4. They hit it with routine chat traffic. I asked for request IDs but they gave a timeframe and example client payload.
lia: Can reproduce locally on a staging node with the same model and seq_len. p95 fine, p99 noisy and has big tail. Instrumented kernel selection shows we pick `flashattn_v2` for seq>512.
mike: Here's the quick repro I used (staging, same bin):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","input":"<~900 token prompt>","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Expected: ~200ms median, p99 ~400ms. Observed: median ok, p99 ~650-900ms intermittently.
priya: Interesting note from logs: kernel-selection debug prints `chosen=flashattn_v2 reason=heuristic_estimation` yet actual per-request timing includes extra memcpy and kernel warmups.
dalia: NVPROF on an affected host shows spikes in device-to-host memcpy after some compiles; looks like JIT/compile pressure when using that compile flag. Could be memory fragmentation causing longer tails.
lia: Also saw occasional fallback to SDPA for the same request but only after first attempt timed out and retried — that adds big tail for p99.
mike: Hypothesis: the compile flag enabled a fast-path that increases on-demand codegen/compilation under certain seq distributions, causing jitter and long-tail p99. When fallback to SDPA occurs it hides immediate failures but lengthens p99.
priya: Triage plan:
- reproduce on a small fleet with tracer enabled
- temporarily prefer SDPA for chat-prod pool to reduce p99
- roll back compile flag from last deploy if toggle confirms mitigation
- run bisect between flags and kernel selection thresholds
- add alert for compile latencies > 200ms

samir: I can push a heuristic override to prefer SDPA for the chat pool. Command (admin CLI):
```
rictl heuristic override --pool chat-prod --prefer sdpa --reason "p99 regression 7060001234"
```
Apply it to 3 nodes first.
lia: Going to run that on staging first.
deploy-bot: rollout: heuristic override applied to staging-chat-01, staging-chat-02, staging-chat-03 (id: ro-7060001234-ovr)
lia: Staging metrics: p99 dropped from ~700ms -> ~380ms within two minutes after override. Median unchanged. This matches hypothesis.
priya: Good. Next steps for prod: schedule a gradual override to prod-chat pool, 25% -> 50% -> 100%, watch p99 and error rates.
dalia: Meanwhile I'll start a bisect job to flip the compile flag per-build and run the latency harness across seq_len buckets. Need a historical artifact from the 7060000000 build.
mike: I'll prepare a hotfix playbook to revert the compile flag in case the override doesn't hold. Also adding a transient throttle for long sequences (cap batch size) as a second-level mitigation.
priya: Can someone capture the kernel-selection log sample and attach it to the ticket? Need exact lines for postmortem.
samir: Pasting sample line from runtime log:
```
[2026-03-17T18:29:41Z] kernel: choose_kernel(model=redwood-chat-1, seq=1024, batch=4) -> flashattn_v2 (est_lat=9.4ms) selected_by=heuristic_v3 flags=FLASH_OPT=1
[2026-03-17T18:29:41Z] runtime: actual_exec_time=876ms, fallback_to=sdpa after 1 attempt
```
priya: Ok that's useful. I'll open a ticket for infra to preserve the affected host images and collect full nvprof traces.
lia: After we confirm prod override reduces p99, we should add a gating experiment: require p95/p99 non-regression across long-seq harness before enabling Flash compile flag in rollouts.
dalia: Also recommend we change heuristic to account for observed compile jitter: add compile_cost_estimate into kernel score and prefer non-JIT path if compile_cost > threshold or if recent compile rate > X/min.
priya: Agreed. I'll coordinate with releases and runtime teams for a rollback window if needed. I'll update the customer and keep them posted.
oncall-bot: paging priya: reminder to update incident tracker (INC-706000) with mitigation steps.
priya: Will do. Triage summary posted in INC-706000. Closing thread here once prod metrics stable. Thanks all :heart:
